abstract: Meigs' syndrome is defined as a hydrothorax with ascites and a pelvic tumor, both of which resolve on removal of the tumor. Pseudo-Meigs' is a variant not possessing the original tumor cell types described by Meigs. Both these syndromes should be considered in otherwise healthy women who present with either new or recurrent hydrothorax and ascites. This case concerns a 21-year-old woman who presented to the emergency department (ED) with a recurrent hydrothorax. After performing a pelvic examination that was suspicious for a pelvic mass, further evaluation by ultrasonography showed ascites and a pelvic tumor. Surgeons from the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department performed an exploratory laparotomy with removal of the tumor. Subsequently, there was no recurrence of the ascites and hydrothorax. The tumor was diagnosed histologically as a benign mature teratoma. The literature of Meigs' and Pseudo-Meigs' is reviewed, focusing on the history, pathology, and clinical characteristics. The clinical significance for the emergency physician is discussed.
abstract_ja: Meigs症候群は、胸水・腹水と骨盤内腫瘍を有し、腫瘍の切除によりいずれも消失する病態と定義される。偽Meigs症候群はその変異型で、Meigsが記載した元の腫瘍細胞型を持たない。両症候群とも、新規または再発性の胸水と腹水を呈する、そうでなければ健康な女性で考慮すべきである。本症例は、再発性胸水で救急部を受診した21歳女性に関するものである。骨盤内診察で骨盤内腫瘤が疑われ、超音波検査で腹水と骨盤内腫瘍が確認された。産婦人科による開腹術で腫瘍を摘出した。組織学的に良性の成熟奇形腫と診断された。その後、腹水および胸水の再発はみられなかった。Meigs症候群および偽Meigs症候群について、歴史、病理、臨床的特徴に焦点を当てて文献を概観し、救急医にとっての臨床的意義を考察した。
